name: Synthetic review fixture, not a real module

interface_contract.input_contract: Attributed sources, definitions, observations, claims, limitations and applicable cultural or ethical context.
interface_contract.prism_output_contract: Separated interpretations, evidence lanes, typed connections, uncertainty, alternatives, investigation state and append-only assessment history.
interface_contract.net_storage_contract: Stable identifiers, provenance-linked records and gated graph relationships; no automatic evidence, rights, canonical or publication promotion.
interface_contract.revision_cycle: New authorised evidence may return the module through AkashicOMNI and AkashicPRISM without erasing earlier assessments.

module_boundary: This module supports inquiry into awareness, consciousness or sentience. Module compatibility, behavioural performance, testimony, biological similarity or computational complexity does not by itself establish subjective experience.
